invariants.rule: DWH lineage and taint state remain explicit, monotonic unless an authorized transformation says otherwise, and traceable to source evidence.
Derived DWH data retains explicit source lineage, transformation provenance and applicable classification/taint state; transformations never silently erase origin or governance metadata.

prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define the Expose monitor for DWH lineage and taint as a read-only graph/timeline projection showing origins, transformations, remote hops, classifications and declassification evidence. [2] Define a read-only Expose monitor for lineage graphs, transformation provenance, classification/taint propagation, declassification evidence and cross-instance/remote origin traces.

references.purpose: DWH lineage view follows generic monitor non-authority semantics.
Monitor reads bounded lineage query surfaces.

semantics.action_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Any remediation/declassification action exposed beside the monitor invokes a separate explicit authorized canonical operation. [2] Reclassify/declassify/import/transform operations invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Viewing lineage does not grant access to hidden underlying data beyond policy. [2] Viewing lineage or classification grants no data/declassification authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual graph adjacency corresponds only to explicit lineage edges.
semantics.identity_rule: Data identity, lineage edge, transformation, instance, remote endpoint and classification metadata remain distinct.
semantics.layout_rule: Graph layout/position is presentation only and does not create lineage edges.
semantics.redaction_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Where source data is restricted, monitor may show authorized metadata/redacted lineage while preserving graph identity according to policy. [2] Sensitive source identities/lineage details may be redacted according to AccessCore/privacy policy.
semantics.source_rule: Monitor reads canonical/runtime lineage and taint query surfaces.
semantics.trace_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Displayed nodes/edges retain exact canonical/lineage refs. [2] Displayed derived output can trace back to exact source/transformation/declassification refs.
